title: Basic Data Types
prompt:
Write a program that declares and initializes variables of different data types (integer, float, string, boolean) and prints out their values.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: Integer: 10, Float: 3.14, String: Hello, Boolean: True
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that declares and initializes variables of different data types (integer, float, string, boolean) and prints out their values:

```python
# Declare and initialize variables of different data types

# Integer
integer = 10
print("Integer:", integer)

# Float
float_number = 3.14
print("Float:", float_number)

# String
string_value = "Hello"
print("String:", string_value)

# Boolean
boolean_value = True
print("Boolean:", boolean_value)

```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
Integer: 10
Float: 3.14
String: Hello
Boolean: True
```

I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions.
